info.text:
Self-storage's best customer is the one who stays.
At Dec 31, 2025, more than half of Public Storage's tenants had rented for over a year (FY2025 10-K).
In 2025 it lowered move-in rates for new tenants while existing long-term tenants got rate increases; total revenue was $4.82 billion, up from $3.42 billion in 2021.
At Dec 31, 2025 it owned and/or operated 3,533 facilities, including 362 it managed for others (Q4 2025 release).
Side income (ancillary revenue), mostly tenant insurance, brought in $334.7 million in 2025.
Our math: same-store net operating income after indirect costs ($2.83B) divided by same-store revenue ($3.76B) is about 75 cents per revenue dollar, before interest, depreciation and corporate overhead. The company's own reported same-store direct margin is 78.2%.
Our math: a $100/month unit for 3 years is $3,600 before any increases.
Sources: Public Storage FY2025 10-K and earlier annual reports; Q4 2025 results release.
News and education, not financial advice.
